notes: Ubuntu v1.1.54: GUI-only dropdown reliability fix built directly on v1.1.53. Ubuntu remains permanently Gold-only with theme selection removed. Repeat/Hindi/Math dropdowns now use Tk's native popup-menu surface so their options stay visible across Ubuntu X11/Wayland/window-manager combinations instead of relying on the previous root-level animated popup frame. Existing automation workflow, speeds, timers, reporting, activation, pairing, queue logic, and Ubuntu 20-50 tab limit are unchanged.
